title: About Sambung Ayat | Credits and Privacy
description: The purpose of Sambung Ayat, how to use it, the sources of the Quran text and audio, and a short privacy policy.
goal.p: Sambung Ayat is a free tool for testing and practicing Quran memorization through multiple-choice quizzes, for students, teachers, parents, and anyone doing murajaah (revision).
goal.note: this app is a revision aid, not a substitute for talaqqi (learning directly with a teacher). Have your recitation checked and corrected by a teacher.
how.1: Choose a mode, a scope (juz or surah), the number of questions, and a difficulty level.
how.2: Answer the questions. Your results and the ayahs to review appear at the end.
how.3: Try the {daily}, or teachers can create a {teacher}.
attr.text: Quran text (Uthmani): {tanzil}. The text is never altered; normalization is used only for internal comparison.
attr.translation: English translation: the {code} edition via AlQuran.cloud/Tanzil.
attr.audio: Recitation audio: {everyayah}, played directly from the source.
attr.font: Arabic font: Amiri Quran (SIL Open Font License).
privacy.p: No accounts and no ads. Your settings, history and mastery stay on your device and can be erased from Settings, "Delete all my data". The website uses Google Analytics for visit statistics; the Android app does not. Your answers are never sent to a server. Details are in the privacy policy.
contact.p: Suggestions, text error reports, or collaboration: see the {contact} page.
